02
Section 02
Dense vs MoE
How does each model “think” on the inside?
Dense model · Model A

Every expert weighs in

It uses all its neurons for every task. Like gathering your whole team of experts: they all talk it over, and only then do you get an answer.

🧠 Solid answer
🐢 Slower
MoE model · Model B

It only calls who knows

Depending on your question, a router picks 2 or 3 experts, loads them in memory and only they answer. It works with part of the model, not all of it.

⚡ Much faster
🎯 Saves resources
In short

Same generation, different balance

Dense
Speed🐢
Intelligence🧠
